b: For today’s prompt, write a poem using at least 3 of the following 6 words: break, fall, left, mean, post, and/or throw. For extra credit, use all 6 words. For extra extra credit, use these 6 words as the end words in a sestina.
Remember: These prompts are springboards to creativity. Use them to expand your possibilities, not limit them.

Here’s my attempt at a Six Words Poem:

I mean, you could break your fall
when you throw a post to the left
but still be left with a post to throw
in fall when you mean to break
with the conventional thought
patterns of those around you
who mean well but are still mean
enough to break dance behind
your back when you fall to the left
or post on social media about
that new throw pillow you like
to throw when the world is mean
and falling over itself to leave you
broken and throwing tantrums
when what you meant was
something else entirely
something entirely else.
